verdict.rationale: Runloop documents a public API with official SDKs in common languages (runloop-docs-23). It also documents a dedicated Agents API (runloop-docs-22) and API-driven operations such as command execution, log streaming, and file access (runloop-docs-59, runloop-docs-60, runloop-docs-63). AI-oriented API context is available via llms.txt, markdown docs, and Cursor rules covering the SDK (runloop-probe-1, runloop-probe-2, runloop-docs-29, runloop-docs-36). Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), an explicitly cited endpoint-level API reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
